name: Fire-Eye Cyclops Zombie (3-4) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-05: Balancing the Scales

generalAbilities.name: Slow
generalAbilities.description: A zombie is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Searing Aura
defensiveAbilities.description:
10 feet. The fire-eye zombie emits an aura of heat that causes open wounds to sizzle.

Any living creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie and isn't at full HP must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude Saving Throw save or take 1d6 Fire Damage damage as its wounds burn.

Creatures critically hit by the fire-eye zombie's Strikes must attempt this saving throw immediately.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Eye Throwing
offensiveAbilities.description:
A fire-eye zombie can launch its eye at foes. While its eye is out of its head, the fire-eye zombie is Blinded.

At the end of its turn, a fire-eye zombie's eye flies back into its eye socket.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wide Swing
offensiveAbilities.description: The fire-eye cyclops zombie makes a spiked club Strike and compares the attack roll result to the AC of up to two foes, each of whom must be within the Strike's reach. This attack counts as two attacks for the fire-eye zombie's multiple attack penalty.
